project_type: Node/Express + Prisma backend + React Native/Expo frontend
build_system: npm with nodemon for dev server
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend with 'npm run dev' and verify no startup crash. 2. Test booking approval: login as counselor → approve pending appointment → login as student → verify 'Confirmed' status and notification received. 3. Test video call invite: counselor starts session → student receives socket invite → student can accept and join.
environment_constraints: Ports 5000 and 8082 may be in use by other dev instances; kill existing processes or run on free port. No changes to port logic needed.
contribution_requirements: Backend must start without crash. Frontend must use existing socketService.ts and navigation patterns. Follow existing file conventions (camelCase for JS, PascalCase for React components).
key_patterns: Backend: use mongoose models in backend/src/models, controller pattern in backend/src/controllers, route registration in backend/server.js. Frontend: use React Navigation, socketService.ts for socket connections, existing patterns in counselor/ and student/ screen folders.
directory_structure: UWell/backend/src/controllers/counselor/ contains notificationController.js, appointmentController.js, etc. UWell/backend/src/routes/counselor/ contains counselorRoutes.js. UWell/frontend/src/screens/ contains student/ and counselor/ subfolders with screens.
